name: levi-vscode-extension
description: Privacy-first AI coding assistant for VS Code using local Ollama models. Review changes before they touch your workspace.

scripts.check: node --check src/extension.js && node --check src/levi-extension.js && node --check src/runtime-loader.js && node --check src/vscode-workspace-adapter.js && node --check src/vscode-workspace-mutation-adapter.js && node --check src/view-providers.js && node --check src/presentation.js && node --check src/virtual-documents.js && node --check src/vscode-credential-resolver.js && node --check src/product-experience/product-experience-controller.js && node --check src/product-experience/copilot-view-provider.js && node --check src/product-experience/home-view-provider.js && node --check src/product-experience/home-readiness.js && node --check src/product-experience/build-wizard-state.js && node --check src/product-experience/build-wizard-view-provider.js && node --check src/product-experience/build-timeline-state.js && node --check src/product-experience/environment-view-provider.js && node --check src/product-experience/timeline-presentation.js && node --check src/product-experience/approval-card-presentation.js && node --check src/product-experience/change-review-presentation.js && node --check src/product-experience/model-picker-controller.js && node --check src/product-experience/onboarding-controller.js && node --check src/product-experience/git-presentation.js && node --check src/product-experience/context-presentation.js && node --check src/product-experience/product-experience-state.js && node --check src/product-experience/product-experience-serializer.js && node --check src/product-experience/product-experience-constants.js

levi.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable Levi in this VS Code installation.

levi.autoInitialize.markdownDescription: Start Levi automatically when VS Code opens a workspace.

levi.autoAnalyzeWorkspace.markdownDescription: Analyze the open workspace after Levi starts.

levi.offlineMode.markdownDescription: Keep AI requests on local models by default. Your source code stays on your machine unless you explicitly enable remote models.

levi.persistence.enabled.description: Persist compact runtime state in extension storage.

levi.workspace.maxFiles.description: Maximum workspace files the adapter lists for a runtime request.

levi.workspace.maxFileBytes.description: Maximum bytes the adapter reads from a single file.

levi.workspace.exclude.description: Glob patterns excluded or deprioritized by the workspace adapter.

levi.diagnostics.enabled.markdownDescription: Show developer and release-check commands. Leave off for normal daily use.

levi.experience.enabled.description: Enable the cohesive Levi product experience.

levi.experience.showAdvancedDetails.markdownDescription: Show advanced technical panels and commands for power users.

levi.experience.autoOpenOnFirstRun.markdownDescription: Open the Levi setup guide the first time you use the extension.

levi.experience.timelineExpanded.description: Expand workflow timeline details by default.

levi.models.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable local and optional remote **AI models**.

levi.models.routingStrategy.markdownDescription: How Levi chooses an AI model when several are available.

levi.models.defaultProvider.markdownDescription: Default AI model provider id (for example `ollama-local`).

levi.models.defaultModel.markdownDescription: Default AI model id or name.

levi.models.allowRemoteSourceCode.markdownDescription: Allow source code to be sent to remote AI providers. Off by default to keep code local.

levi.models.allowRemoteSensitiveContent.markdownDescription: Allow sensitive workspace content to be sent to remote AI providers.

levi.models.requestTimeoutMs.description: Model provider request timeout in milliseconds.

levi.ollama.enabled.markdownDescription: Connect Levi to a local [Ollama](https://ollama.com) server.

levi.ollama.defaultModel.markdownDescription: Default Ollama model name (for example `qwen2.5-coder:7b`). Install models with `ollama pull` first.

levi.openAICompatible.enabled.description: Enable an OpenAI-compatible remote provider package.

levi.openAICompatible.credentialKey.description: Secret-storage reference for the provider API key.

levi.agent.enabled.description: Enable the Levi agent orchestration UI.

levi.agent.maximumTurns.description: Maximum turns per Levi agent conversation.

levi.agent.maximumToolCalls.description: Maximum tool calls per Levi agent turn.

levi.agent.enableStreaming.description: Enable streaming model responses into the Levi Agent UI.

levi.agent.requirePlanForProtectedAction.description: Require a plan before protected agent actions.

levi.agent.autoCreateConversation.description: Create an agent conversation automatically when sending the first message.

levi.agent.persistConversationSummaries.description: Persist compact Levi agent conversation summaries.

levi.workspaceTools.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable reviewed file-change proposals in your workspace.

levi.workspaceTools.allowSourceChanges.description: Allow approved Levi proposals to mutate workspace files.

levi.workspaceTools.allowCommandExecutio.description: Allow approved Levi validation commands to execute.

levi.workspaceTools.allowFileCreation.description: Allow approved Levi proposals to create files.

levi.workspaceTools.allowFileDeletion.description: Allow approved Levi proposals to delete files.

levi.workspaceTools.allowFileRename.description: Allow approved Levi proposals to rename files.

levi.workspaceTools.requireApproval.markdownDescription: Require your explicit approval before Levi changes files or runs validation commands.

levi.workspaceTools.requireCheckpoint.description: Request source-control checkpoint support before workspace mutation.

levi.multiAgent.maximumAgents.description: Maximum specialized roles per Levi team.

levi.multiAgent.requireIndependentChange.description: Require independent review for source-changing multi-agent proposals.

levi.multiAgent.requireSecurityReviewFor.description: Require security review for sensitive multi-agent work when available.

levi.multiAgent.allowSameModelForReview.description: Allow review roles to use the same model while surfacing the limitation.

levi.workflows.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable **Project Rules** workflows for repeatable multi-step tasks.

levi.workflows.maximumStepsPerWorkflow.description: Maximum steps in a workflow graph.

levi.workflows.maximumRetriesPerStep.description: Maximum bounded retries per workflow step.

levi.workflows.maximumRepairAttempts.description: Maximum bounded repair attempts per failed workflow step.

levi.workflows.allowSafeAutomaticResume.description: Allow only safe read-only workflow steps to resume automatically after revalidation.

levi.performance.maximumMemoryBytes.description: Maximum memory budget for performance metadata.

levi.performance.cacheTtlMs.description: Repository performance cache TTL in milliseconds.

levi.performance.maximumParallelism.description: Maximum safe parallel repository analysis lanes.

levi.performance.persistSummaries.description: Persist compact repository performance summaries only.

levi.performance.benchmarkSampleSize.description: Deterministic sample size for repository benchmarks.

levi.reliability.failClosed.description: Fail closed on reliability invariant violations.

levi.reliability.requireProtectedActionN.description: Require proof that protected actions do not auto-resume after recovery.

levi.reliability.persistReports.description: Persist compact reliability reports and summaries.

levi.securityAssurance.failClosed.description: Fail closed on security assurance blocker conditions.

levi.securityAssurance.maximumScenariosP.description: Maximum threat scenarios per security audit run.

levi.securityAssurance.maximumPayloadByt.description: Maximum hostile payload bytes retained for diagnostic simulation.

levi.securityAssurance.maximumPromptChar.description: Maximum prompt characters considered by security diagnostics.

levi.securityAssurance.maximumToolArgume.description: Maximum tool argument bytes considered by security diagnostics.

levi.securityAssurance.maximumWebviewMes.description: Maximum webview message bytes considered by security diagnostics.

levi.securityAssurance.maximumAgentDepth.description: Maximum recursive agent depth assumed by diagnostics.

levi.securityAssurance.maximumWorkflowSt.description: Maximum workflow steps assumed by diagnostics.

levi.securityAssurance.maximumAttackVari.description: Maximum attack variants per threat scenario.

levi.securityAssurance.enablePathTests.description: Enable path and URI safety diagnostics.

levi.securityAssurance.enableWebviewTest.description: Enable VS Code webview security diagnostics.

levi.securityAssurance.requireWorkspaceT.description: Require workspace trust for protected security posture.

levi.securityAssurance.requireExplicitPr.description: Require explicit user approval for protected operations.

levi.securityAssurance.requireSecretReda.description: Require secret redaction in security evidence.

levi.securityAssurance.requireRemotePriv.description: Require remote provider privacy policy enforcement.

levi.securityAssurance.persistReports.description: Persist compact redacted security reports and summaries.

levi.stressScalability.enabled.description: Enable deterministic stress and scalability diagnostics.

levi.stressScalability.failClosed.description: Fail closed on release-candidate stress blockers.

levi.stressScalability.maximumSyntheticF.description: Maximum synthetic repository files modeled by diagnostics.

levi.stressScalability.maximumSyntheticD.description: Maximum synthetic directories modeled by diagnostics.

levi.stressScalability.maximumSyntheticS.description: Maximum synthetic symbols modeled by diagnostics.

levi.stressScalability.maximumSyntheticD.description: Maximum synthetic dependencies modeled by diagnostics.

levi.stressScalability.maximumRepository.description: Maximum synthetic repository bytes modeled by diagnostics.

levi.stressScalability.maximumEventRateP.description: Maximum modeled event rate per second.

levi.stressScalability.maximumPersistenc.description: Maximum persistence cycles per diagnostic scenario.

levi.stressScalability.maximumRecoveryCy.description: Maximum recovery cycles per diagnostic scenario.

levi.stressScalability.maximumWarmupDura.description: Maximum warmup duration per stress scenario.

levi.stressScalability.maximumCooldownDu.description: Maximum cooldown duration per stress scenario.

levi.stressScalability.memoryBudgetBytes.description: Memory budget used by stress diagnostics.

levi.stressScalability.warningMemoryRati.description: Memory ratio that produces warning-level evidence.

levi.stressScalability.criticalMemoryRat.description: Memory ratio that produces blocker-level evidence.

levi.stressScalability.persistReports.description: Persist compact stress reports and run summaries.

levi.qualification.failClosed.description: Fail closed on release qualification blockers.

levi.qualification.maximumGeneratedFiles.description: Maximum generated files per qualification fixture.

levi.qualification.requireExtensionHostV.description: Require manual Extension Development Host verification for RC qualification.

levi.qualification.requireLocalModelVeri.description: Require manual local Ollama verification for RC qualification.

levi.qualification.requireNoCriticalDefe.description: Block qualification while critical defects remain open.
